maddeler.e:
يصحام (form XI)
# يَصْحَامُّ (yaṣḥāmmu) /jasˤ.ħaːm.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِصْحَامَّ (iṣḥāmma)
# يَصْحَامَّ (yaṣḥāmma) /jasˤ.ħaːm.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْحَامَّ (iṣḥāmma)
# يَصْحَامِّ (yaṣḥāmmi) /jasˤ.ħaːm.mi/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِصْحَامَّ (iṣḥāmma)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
